n1.speaker: npc_marrow
n1.text: You went against the Rubric. That's permitted. I'll want the reason in the margin, and I'll want it to be a reason.

n2.speaker: npc_marrow
n2.text: This one comes with a glowing summary. Summaries are written by somebody.

n3.speaker: npc_marrow
n3.text: Walk to the Records annexe, ask Pell for the originals, and see whether the file survives the trip.

n4.speaker: npc_marrow
n4.text: If a record and an original disagree, select both at your desk and LINK them. Only if they truly disagree; guessing costs.

n5.speaker: npc_marrow
n5.text: And when you stamp, cite one ground from your notes. A verdict without a reason is a coin toss with ink.
